description: Search speeches in the Swiss Parliament (both chambers, current legislature, Official Bulletin index): who spoke, in which council, when, for how long, on which item, with a link to the bulletin. Filter by speaker, business number, session or date. For what a whole session dealt with (dates, sittings, longest debates, final votes) use parliament_session.

business.description: Business number of the item, e.g. "26.033".

date.description: Day of the sitting as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-09-15".

session.description: Session id from parliament_session, e.g. 5206; omit for all sessions.

speaker.description: Name of the member of parliament who spoke, e.g. "Pfister" or "Gerhard Pfister".

name: search_speeches
title: Search parliament speeches
